long_biography.plain_text:
Long-term partnerships sit at the centre of Pears Foundation’s model. It provides core funding and organisational support to groups working on wellbeing, education and social justice, drawing on resources generated by the Pears family business. Trevor Pears directs that programme full time, shaping both its funding practice and institutional collaborations.

The commercial base began in 1952 under Bernard and Clive Pears. It has since developed into a family-owned real-estate and financing group that reinvests property profits or directs them towards philanthropy. Trevor remains a board director rather than the group chief executive, a post held by Mark Pears. His day-to-day focus is the charitable institution, where the brothers’ shared ownership legacy is converted into sustained grant-making.
